verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents automatic user provisioning, so changes made to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to connected third-party apps. That covers the deprovisioning-across-apps part of offboarding. Nothing in the evidence shows that deactivating a user kills active sessions, that the propagation is immediate, or that the whole flow is a single action. Missing for 10: documented session revocation on suspension or deactivation, evidence of immediate propagation of deprovisioning, a documented one-action offboarding flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, offboarding is one action — deactivating a user kills their sessions and deprovisions their accounts across connected apps immediately

citations.quote: Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
אתם יכולים להגדיר הקצאת הרשאות אוטומטית למשתמשים כדי שכל השינויים שתבצעו בחשבונות המשתמשים ב-Google Workspace יסונכרנו אוטומטית עם אפליקציית הצד השלישי הזאת.
